summary: Reverse-engineered the skill-training screen (screen-13) layout by reading the engine's live window cell-grid memory from DOSBox save state 1. Found the skillTrain window struct at DGROUP+0x7e26, extracted full 20×16 cell grid with character names, attribute values, selection highlight semantics, and skill-points display. Confirmed category cycle mechanism (WEAPONRY only visible, next category on key-5), font2 portrait patch persists from prior screen.

skillTrain_window_handle.note: This is a stack-local temporary window created by wpcmk_skill_training_loop (0x1ae9) at call site 0x1b28. The handle is returned into [bp-0x4] but also persists in memory during render. DGROUP+0x7e26 is the struct base; handle at +0x10 contains the cell grid.

cell_grid_layout.description: 20x16 cell window rendered at skill-training screen. Shows WEAPONRY category header (row 1), 9 skill names (rows 3-11, left-aligned), bonus values (right-aligned rows 3-11), SKILL POINTS label (row 14), skill-points count (row 14, right-aligned), and WAND&DAGGER selected (row 3, attr 0x20 on name, 0x40 on d glyph, 0x10 on bonus area).

layout.row_0: Frame top (char 0x0c horizontal, 0x0a top-right corner, attr 0x01)
layout.row_1: Frame left + WEAPONRY header text (WEAPONRY at cols 6-13, attr 0x03) + frame right
layout.rows_3_to_11: Skill entries: Frame left (0x0d) + skill name left-aligned (cols 1-15, attr 0x20) + bonus value right-aligned (cols 17-18, attr 0x10) + frame right (0x05). WAND&DAGGER (row 3) has attr 0x20 on name but 0x40 on d glyph (selected), 0x10 for bonus area.
layout.row_14: SKILL POINTS label (cols 1-12, attr 0x90 inverted) + bonus count at col 18 (attr 0x10)
layout.row_15: Frame bottom (char 0x07 horizontal, 0x08 bottom-right corner, attr 0x01)

selection_highlight_semantics.claim: Selected skill row uses attr 0x40 (inverted palette) with wfont1 black
selection_highlight_semantics.note: attr 0x40 matches documented attr_lo=0 highlight path

category_cycle_mechanism.claim: Only WEAPONRY visible; cycles to PHYSICAL, PERSONAL, ACADEMIA on successive key-5 presses

font2_portrait_patch_status.claim: wfont2 persists from screen-10 into screen-13
font2_portrait_patch_status.implication: TS port must not restore wfont2 after portrait picker
